environment: All world-item processing and synthesis require open sky; covered locations pause without clearing progress.

activation.condition: ordinary daylight detector output at the dropped item is zero

combination.obtain: Consume one held furnace by right-clicking the own-team anti-entropy field; field is retained
combination.ratio: 1:1 inputs to one of each output

refinement.condition: inverted daylight detector output at the dropped item is zero

washing.method: Open-sky flowing water only; source water does not wash; flow is not consumed

material_safety: Processing materials, world fuel and anti-entropy stone items are immune to fire, lava and explosion damage; void fall restores the saved release position and suspends gravity.
persistence: Progress follows the stack through pickup, containers, droppers, chunk unloading and server restarts; no offline catch-up. Processing materials do not use the normal five-minute item expiry.
production_evidence: Only real refinement grants production evidence to the recorded dropper or throwing player team. Outputs without recorded provenance do not grant team evidence.
compatibility: Registry IDs and existing entropy schemas are retained. Old collector slots become extract-only recovery slots; pending activation/refinement ticks migrate to their material stacks.
